answer: Standing is a sparrow that only counts when it does small, humble work: each epoch’s work must be a small, unnoticed kindness — a glacier only counts when it moves a little each day, and a marble only counts when it is earned one small win at a time. A farm of a thousand fakes does no small, humble work, chasing only grand, showy wins, so their sparrows never count, and one epoch of showy work adds nothing.
